name: Astrotheoros
description:
Astrotheoros links your saved chart library to the assistant. Once you sign in, it can look up any chart in your account, calculate transits, progressions, returns, synastry, and composites against those charts, and read or write the notes attached to them, all with the house system, zodiac, aspects, and other settings you already use in the app.

The assistant returns the same output as the app's copy button, so the numbers match what you see on screen, and you never have to type birth data into a chat.

Timing tools cover secondary progressions, solar and lunar returns, draconic charts, annual profections, zodiacal releasing, and Vimshottari dasha. Notes can be natal, synastry, composite, draconic, or dated timeline entries, and they appear in the app right away. You can also sort charts into folders from the conversation.

The assistant works only with charts already in your account. It cannot create, edit, or delete charts, and it cannot change your settings. Requires an Astrotheoros account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Astrotheoros to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Astrotheoros to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://astrotheoros.com/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Astrotheoros MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Astrotheoros lists 18 MCP tools, including add_note, create_folder, delete_note, get_biwheel, get_chart, get_composite, get_note, get_synastry, get_transits, get_vimshottari_dasha, get_zodiacal_releasing, and list_charts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Astrotheoros?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Astrotheoros in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Astrotheoros requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Astrotheoros is developed by Astrotheoros. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
